overview: Hollowshade Moor is defined by its tribal conflict, shifting territorial control, and dangerous wilds.
history: The Owlbears, Sonic Wolves, and Grimlings have fought for dominance for generations.
The Warfront Basin became the central battlefield due to its strategic location.
Vah Shir scouts established the Cliffside Watch to monitor tribal movements.
The Wetlands formed from ancient subterranean springs and forgotten rituals.
During Shar Vahl Reborn, tribal raids intensified and control shifted more frequently.
hooks: A tribe unexpectedly gains control of the Warfront Basin.
A regional event destabilizes multiple zones.
A Vah Shir scout reports a major tribal movement.
A heroic intervention shifts regional balance.
